description: A Dart script that automates running Flutter commands such as pub get, analyze, and test, by executing shell processes and streaming their output.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main entry point that sequentially runs Flutter pub get, analyze, and test commands, exiting with code 1 on failure.

methods.name: run
methods.description: A helper asynchronous function that starts a process with given arguments, pipes its output to stdout and stderr, and returns its exit code.
